items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: The interviewee refers to Monk Rowe only in the boilerplate as the interviewer/director and in the interviewer's self-introduction. The interviewee does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe in their spoken turns.

ctx.x: Did you remain close with Bill until his death?

Yes. Very close, but in a strange kind of way. Pool playing close. Bowling close. Golf driving range close. Going to movies together. You know, he’d be coming over for dinner. I remember my fortieth birthday was in this house and he brings out the cake. So that was fun. So we were friends. And he was ten years older than I. And he considered himself to be a regular guy from New Jersey. He said, “I know all this stuff” and blah- blah-blah and everything, “but what I am is what I am. Do you want to go shoot some…
I wish we’d have had a camera for some of that.
